decisions.statement: A leaf's coverage is the rank of its own mastery level.
A branch weighs its own rank and the mean of its children equally.
A child no coverage is worked out for counts nought in the mean of the children.
Coverage runs unbroken over the same nought-to-seven scale a mastery level is ranked on.
A branch's coverage is unmoved by a child added or dropped at the mean of the other children.
Raising a child's coverage raises the coverage of the branch above that child.
Lowering a child's coverage lowers the coverage of the branch above that child.
A branch weighs its own rank at one half however many children sit beneath that branch.
One half is the even split chosen rather than a weight these truths force.

definition: how far Alan has got into a topic and all beneath it
